# Danish interface strings: English: — MiB per minute; empty uses Settings › Quality
— MiB pr. minut; tom bruger Indstillinger › Kvalitet

# Danish interface strings: English: — a release's size is multiplied by its codec's factor before the size limits apply
— en udgivelses størrelse ganges med dens codecs faktor, før størrelsesgrænserne anvendes

# Danish interface strings: English: — codec and title criteria, custom qualities (Tanukarr)
0 (off) or 10 to 120. RSS sync also runs from System › Tasks.
0 (fra) eller 10 til 120. RSS-synkronisering kan også køres fra System › Opgaver.

# Danish interface strings: English: A downloading torrent with no progress for this long is failed, blocklisted and searched again. 0 turns this off; progress is tracked from Kitsunarr's start.
En torrent under download uden fremskridt i så lang tid markeres som mislykket, blokeres og søges igen. 0 slår dette fra; fremskridt følges fra Kitsunarrs start.

# Danish interface strings: English: A franchise group found from AniList or MyAnimeList relations. Titles added later from the same franchise still join it.
En franchisegruppe fundet ud fra relationer i AniList eller MyAnimeList. Titler fra samme franchise, der tilføjes senere, kommer også med.

# Danish interface strings: English: A new API key was generated. Update the applications that use it.
En ny API-nøgle blev genereret. Opdater de programmer, der bruger den.

# Danish interface strings: English: A regular expression, case-insensitive; empty matches every title.
Et regulært udtryk uden forskel på store og små bogstaver; tomt matcher alle titler.

# Danish interface strings: English: A release takes the most specific preset allowed in its series' profile whose source, resolution, codec and title pattern it matches. A standard quality given a codec or pattern turns releases that fail it into Unknown. Custom presets are added to every profile as not allowed.
En udgivelse får den mest specifikke forudindstilling, der er tilladt i seriens profil, og hvis kilde, opløsning, codec og titelmønster den matcher. En standardkvalitet med et codec eller mønster gør udgivelser, der ikke opfylder det, til Ukendt. Tilpassede forudindstillinger tilføjes til alle profiler som ikke tilladt.

# Danish interface strings: English: A release's size is multiplied by its codec's factor before the size limits apply. "Mixed" means profiles use different factors; a value entered here is written into every profile.
En udgivelses størrelse ganges med dens codecs faktor, før størrelsesgrænserne anvendes. "Blandet" betyder, at profilerne bruger forskellige faktorer; en værdi indtastet her skrives i alle profiler.

# Danish interface strings: English: A title joining a franchise or manual group leaves the group it was in. Files and folders are not moved.
En titel, der kommer med i en franchise eller manuel gruppe, forlader den gruppe, den var i. Filer og mapper flyttes ikke.

# Danish interface strings: English: Absolute path; empty to delete permanently.
Absolut sti; tom for at slette permanent.

# Danish interface strings: English: Add a Newznab or Torznab indexer and enable interactive search for it.
Tilføj en Newznab- eller Torznab-indekser, og aktivér interaktiv søgning for den.

# Danish interface strings: English: Add a client from its template and use Test in the editor; grabs, the queue and imports use every enabled client. A blackhole writes grabs to a folder and imports what appears in its watch folder. Each client's "Remove completed/failed downloads" options remove downloads (with their files) once the client is done with them.
Tilføj en klient fra dens skabelon, og brug Afprøv i editoren; hentninger, køen og importer bruger alle aktiverede klienter. Et blackhole skriver hentninger til en mappe og importerer det, der dukker op i dens overvågede mappe. Hver klients indstillinger "Fjern fuldførte/mislykkede downloads" fjerner downloads (med deres filer), når klienten er færdig med dem.

# Danish interface strings: English: Add a download client in Settings › Download clients and enable it.
Tilføj en downloadklient under Indstillinger › Downloadklienter, og aktivér den.

# Danish interface strings: English: Add a root folder first: it is where this title's folder will live.
Tilføj først en rodmappe: det er der, titlens mappe skal ligge.

# Danish interface strings: English: Add one, or migrate them from Sonarr/Tanukarr.
Tilføj en, eller migrér dem fra Sonarr/Tanukarr.

# Danish interface strings: English: Add titles from TVmaze or AniList, or bring over an existing Sonarr or Tanukarr library.
Tilføj titler fra TVmaze eller AniList, eller hent et eksisterende Sonarr- eller Tanukarr-bibliotek over.

# Danish interface strings: English: Add, and remove when they leave the list
Tilføj, og fjern når de forlader listen

# Danish interface strings: English: Added to the titles this list adds.
Føjes til de titler, som denne liste tilføjer.

# Danish interface strings: English: Aired monitored episodes without a file appear here.
Sendte overvågede episoder uden fil vises her.

# Danish interface strings: English: All episodes in the series folder
Allow zero size (the feed has no release sizes)
Tillad størrelse nul (feedet har ingen udgivelsesstørrelser)

# Danish interface strings: English: Also delete the series folder and its files (to the recycle bin when one is set)
Slet også seriemappen og dens filer (til papirkurven, hvis en er angivet)

# Danish interface strings: English: Also for releases grabbed from interactive search
Også for udgivelser hentet fra interaktiv søgning

# Danish interface strings: English: Always, even when renaming is off
Altid, selv når omdøbning er slået fra

# Danish interface strings: English: Analyze video files (resolution, runtime and codecs, with ffprobe)
Analysér videofiler (opløsning, spilletid og codecs, med ffprobe)

# Danish interface strings: English: AniList and MyAnimeList titles are always added as anime.
Titler fra AniList og MyAnimeList tilføjes altid som anime.

# Danish interface strings: English: AniList, MyAnimeList, Trakt, Simkl, TMDB, MDBList, Plex, another Sonarr and custom JSON lists are read every few hours; new titles are added with each list's root folder, profile and monitoring. Services that need OAuth use your own application's Client ID and a token you paste (tokens migrated from Tanukarr keep working).
Lister fra AniList, MyAnimeList, Trakt, Simkl, TMDB, MDBList, Plex, en anden Sonarr og tilpassede JSON-lister læses med få timers mellemrum; nye titler tilføjes med hver listes rodmappe, profil og overvågning. Tjenester, der kræver OAuth, bruger din egen applikations Client ID og et token, som du indsætter (tokens migreret fra Tanukarr virker fortsat).

# Danish interface strings: English: Anime films can be added from AniList, and Tanukarr migrations bring their movies along. Live-action films need the TMDB catalogue.
Animefilm kan tilføjes fra AniList, og migreringer fra Tanukarr tager deres film med. Live action-film kræver TMDB-kataloget.

# Danish interface strings: English: Applications using the current key will stop working until you give them the new one.
Programmer, der bruger den nuværende nøgle, holder op med at virke, indtil du giver dem den nye.

# Danish interface strings: English: Applied after every list has been read successfully and some title left a list.
Anvendes, når alle lister er læst uden fejl, og en titel har forladt en liste.

# Danish interface strings: English: At least {MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} characters. A passphrase works well.
Mindst {MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} tegn. En adgangssætning fungerer godt.

# Danish interface strings: English: Auto tag saved. It applies when titles are next added, edited or refreshed.
Automatisk etiket gemt. Den anvendes, næste gang titler tilføjes, redigeres eller opdateres.

# Danish interface strings: English: Automatic search for {label}: {} releases found, {} approved, nothing grabbed.
Automatisk søgning efter {label}: udgivelser fundet: {}, godkendt: {}, intet hentet.

# Danish interface strings: English: Automatic search: grab the best release
Automatisk søgning: hent den bedste udgivelse

# Danish interface strings: English: Automation is paused: RSS sync, scheduled list syncs and automatic searches are skipped. Manual actions and current downloads continue.
Automatisering er sat på pause: RSS-synkronisering, planlagte listesynkroniseringer og automatiske søgninger springes over. Manuelle handlinger og igangværende downloads fortsætter.

# Danish interface strings: English: Blocklist the release and search again
Blocklist the release: it is never grabbed again
Blokér udgivelsen: den hentes aldrig igen

# Danish interface strings: English: Blocklist “{title}” and search for a replacement?
Blokér “{title}”, og søg efter en erstatning?

# Danish interface strings: English: Bring your Sonarr (v3/v4) or Tanukarr library and settings into Kitsunarr. The source is only read, never changed, and
Hent dit Sonarr- (v3/v4) eller Tanukarr-bibliotek og dine indstillinger ind i Kitsunarr. Kilden læses kun, ændres aldrig, og

# Danish interface strings: English: Bypass the proxy for local addresses
Gå uden om proxyen for lokale adresser

# Danish interface strings: English: Check that the mapped series folders exist (read-only)
Kontrollér, at de tilknyttede seriemapper findes (skrivebeskyttet)

# Danish interface strings: English: Choose a root folder and a quality profile.
Vælg en rodmappe og en kvalitetsprofil.

# Danish interface strings: English: Choose a series and a season or episode. Results show what each release is, as Kitsunarr's parser reads it.
Vælg en serie og en sæson eller episode. Resultaterne viser, hvad hver udgivelse er, som Kitsunarrs parser læser den.

# Danish interface strings: English: Choose the episodes of this release by hand, then grab it (the choice is kept for the import)
Vælg denne udgivelses episoder manuelt, og hent den derefter (valget bevares til importen)

# Danish interface strings: English: Codec factors saved in every profile.
Collections appear when they are migrated from Tanukarr, created from provider data, or created here.
Samlinger vises, når de migreres fra Tanukarr, oprettes ud fra udbyderdata eller oprettes her.

# Danish interface strings: English: Coming from Sonarr or Tanukarr? Import your existing series, settings and history in a few steps.
Kommer du fra Sonarr eller Tanukarr? Importér dine eksisterende serier, indstillinger og historik i få trin.

# Danish interface strings: English: Comma-separated; * is a wildcard (*.lan), and IP ranges like 192.168.1.0/24 work.
Kommasepareret; * er et jokertegn (*.lan), og IP-intervaller som 192.168.1.0/24 virker.
Håndtering af fuldførte og mislykkede downloads

# Danish interface strings: English: Conditions of one kind match when any of them matches (all the required ones must); every kind must match.
Betingelser af samme type matcher, når en af dem matcher (alle påkrævede skal); alle typer skal matche.

# Danish interface strings: English: Consistent copies of the database. Scheduled backups run weekly (the last eight are kept); every migration also creates one first. To restore, stop Kitsunarr and run
Konsistente kopier af databasen. Planlagte sikkerhedskopier køres ugentligt (de seneste otte bevares); hver migrering opretter også først en. For at gendanne skal du stoppe Kitsunarr og køre

# Danish interface strings: English: Cookie (sent with the feed request, e.g. uid=1; pass=…)
Cookie (sendes med feed-forespørgslen, f.eks. uid=1; pass=…)

# Danish interface strings: English: Copy the token now; it is not shown again:
Kopiér tokenet nu; det vises ikke igen:

# Danish interface strings: English: Create one at themoviedb.org › Settings › API. Used for TMDB TV series and films.
Opret en på themoviedb.org › Settings › API. Bruges til TV-serier og film fra TMDB.

# Danish interface strings: English: Create the administrator account. You will use it to sign in to Kitsunarr.
Opret administratorkontoen. Du skal bruge den til at logge ind på Kitsunarr.

# Danish interface strings: English: Created when the first file is imported. Nothing is written to disk now.
Oprettes, når den første fil importeres. Der skrives intet til disken nu.

# Danish interface strings: English: Database backup taken before the import: {b}
Sikkerhedskopi af databasen taget før importen: {b}

# Danish interface strings: English: Delete “{path}”? It goes to the recycle bin when one is set.
Slet “{path}”? Den flyttes til papirkurven, hvis en er angivet.

# Danish interface strings: English: Delete “{}”? Its series and movies stay in the library.
Slet “{}”? Dens serier og film bliver i biblioteket.

# Danish interface strings: English: Do not search for a replacement
Each title belongs to one catalogue, which its refreshes read; every identifier it carries (TheTVDB, TMDB, IMDb, TVmaze, AniList, MyAnimeList) is kept. Titles migrated from Sonarr belong to TheTVDB.
Hver titel hører til ét katalog, som dens opdateringer læser fra; alle de id'er, den har (TheTVDB, TMDB, IMDb, TVmaze, AniList, MyAnimeList), bevares. Titler migreret fra Sonarr hører til TheTVDB.

# Danish interface strings: English: Episode image thumbs in the NFO
Episode order changed: {} episodes updated, {} added.
Episodes are renumbered by the chosen order; files, monitoring and history stay with their episodes. Rename files afterwards to match the new numbers.
Episoderne omnummereres efter den valgte rækkefølge; filer, overvågning og historik følger deres episoder. Omdøb derefter filerne, så de passer til de nye numre.

# Danish interface strings: English: Episodes whose file is below the quality profile's cutoff appear here.
Episoder, hvis fil ligger under kvalitetsprofilens grænse, vises her.

# Danish interface strings: English: Every file already follows the naming settings.
Fake release protection: inspect torrents before grabbing them and reject executables, password-bait archives and contents with no video
Beskyttelse mod falske udgivelser: undersøg torrents, før de hentes, og afvis eksekverbare filer, adgangskodebeskyttede lokkearkiver og indhold uden video

# Danish interface strings: English: Files older than this are deleted from the recycle bin daily; 0 keeps them.
Filer, der er ældre end dette, slettes dagligt fra papirkurven; 0 beholder dem.

# Danish interface strings: English: Files upgrades replaced, kept as versions
Filer erstattet af opgraderinger, bevaret som versioner

# Danish interface strings: English: Film title or IMDb id, e.g. Arrival
Find a series in your library
Find en serie i dit bibliotek

# Danish interface strings: English: Find files added to or removed from the series folder
Find filer, der er tilføjet til eller fjernet fra seriemappen

# Danish interface strings: English: Formats use Sonarr's specification types (ReleaseTitle, ReleaseGroup, Source, Resolution, Language, Size, IndexerFlag, ReleaseType). Scores are assigned per quality profile.
Formater bruger Sonarrs specifikationstyper (ReleaseTitle, ReleaseGroup, Source, Resolution, Language, Size, IndexerFlag, ReleaseType). Scorer tildeles pr. kvalitetsprofil.

# Danish interface strings: English: Grab a release from interactive search; downloads in the client's TV category show up here.
Hent en udgivelse fra interaktiv søgning; downloads i klientens TV-kategori vises her.

# Danish interface strings: English: Grabs, imports and file changes appear here. Migrated history is included.
Hentninger, importer og filændringer vises her. Migreret historik er inkluderet.

# Danish interface strings: English: Groups of related series and movies: provider collections, anime franchises (prequel/sequel groups) and manual groups, including those migrated from Tanukarr.
Grupper af relaterede serier og film: udbydersamlinger, animefranchises (prequel/sequel-grupper) og manuelle grupper, herunder dem migreret fra Tanukarr.

# Danish interface strings: English: Hardlink-only imports: never copy downloads that keep seeding
Import kun med hardlinks: kopiér aldrig downloads, der stadig seedes

# Danish interface strings: English: Host (as in the download client's settings)
How the catalogue numbers the episodes (it can be changed later on the series page).
Hvordan kataloget nummererer episoderne (kan ændres senere på seriens side).

# Danish interface strings: English: If Kitsunarr sees your media under different paths than the source (for example different Docker volumes), map each source folder to its Kitsunarr location. Paths are only rewritten in the database.
Hvis Kitsunarr ser dine medier under andre stier end kilden (for eksempel andre Docker-volumener), så knyt hver kildemappe til dens placering i Kitsunarr. Stierne omskrives kun i databasen.

# Danish interface strings: English: Import a Sonarr or Tanukarr library
Import video files from any folder the server can read: check the series and episodes each file is for, then copy or move them into the library (renamed by the naming settings).
Importér videofiler fra en hvilken som helst mappe, serveren kan læse: kontrollér serien og episoderne for hver fil, og kopiér eller flyt dem derefter ind i biblioteket (omdøbt efter navngivningsindstillingerne).

# Danish interface strings: English: Include in file names ({{Custom Formats}} token)
Include only titles on some lists, or leave out the titles of others.
Medtag kun titler fra visse lister, eller udelad titlerne fra andre.

# Danish interface strings: English: Including the URL base, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8989 or https://host/sonarr
Inklusive URL-basen, f.eks. http://192.168.1.10:8989 eller https://host/sonarr

# Danish interface strings: English: Interactive search for full-season packs only
Interaktiv søgning kun efter pakker med hele sæsoner

# Danish interface strings: English: Interactive search for packs of the whole series (and of its seasons) on torrent indexers
Interaktiv søgning efter pakker med hele serien (og dens sæsoner) på torrent-indeksere

# Danish interface strings: English: Interactive search: see every release and choose
Interaktiv søgning: se alle udgivelser, og vælg

# Danish interface strings: English: Keep files replaced by upgrades as versions (in "Plex Versions")
Bevar filer erstattet af opgraderinger som versioner (i "Plex Versions")

# Danish interface strings: English: Keys for companion apps using the Sonarr v3 API: they read the library, and "add series" keys can also add series (into a root folder, without searching). Nothing else is allowed.
Nøgler til ledsagende apps, der bruger Sonarr v3 API: de læser biblioteket, og nøgler med "tilføj serie" kan også tilføje serier (i en rodmappe, uden søgning). Intet andet er tilladt.

# Danish interface strings: English: Kitsunarr will back up its own database, import the previewed data in one transaction and validate it before committing. The source and your media files are not modified.
Kitsunarr tager en sikkerhedskopi af sin egen database, importerer de forhåndsviste data i én transaktion og validerer dem, før de gemmes. Kilden og dine mediefiler ændres ikke.

# Danish interface strings: English: Larger releases are rejected. 0 means unlimited.
Listed best first. Grouped qualities rank equally.
Bedste først. Grupperede kvaliteter rangerer ens.

# Danish interface strings: English: Metadata settings saved. Files are written at the next disk scan, refresh or import.
Metadataindstillinger gemt. Filerne skrives ved næste diskscanning, opdatering eller import.

# Danish interface strings: English: More languages can be added to the string tables.
Flere sprog kan tilføjes til teksttabellerne.

# Danish interface strings: English: Movie removed from Kitsunarr. Files on disk were not touched.
Film fjernet fra Kitsunarr. Filerne på disken blev ikke rørt.

# Danish interface strings: English: Multi-season releases: accept packs of several seasons (a season search takes the pack for its season)
Udgivelser med flere sæsoner: acceptér pakker med flere sæsoner (en sæsonsøgning tager pakken for sin sæson)

# Danish interface strings: English: No delay above the minimum custom format score
Ingen forsinkelse over minimumsscoren for tilpassede formater

# Danish interface strings: English: No delay for the profile's best quality in the preferred protocol
Ingen forsinkelse for profilens bedste kvalitet i den foretrukne protokol

# Danish interface strings: English: No indexer can search this series automatically: none has automatic search enabled and either no tags or one of the series' tags.
Ingen indekser kan søge automatisk efter denne serie: ingen har både automatisk søgning aktiveret og enten ingen etiketter eller en af seriens etiketter.

# Danish interface strings: English: No kept versions. Turn on "Keep files replaced by upgrades" in Naming.
Ingen bevarede versioner. Slå "Bevar filer erstattet af opgraderinger" til under Navngivning.

# Danish interface strings: English: No log entries at this level
No migrations have been run yet.
Der er ikke kørt nogen migreringer endnu.

# Danish interface strings: English: No recycle bin is set (Settings › Media management).
Der er ikke angivet nogen papirkurv (Indstillinger › Mediehåndtering).

# Danish interface strings: English: No series in your library match.
Ingen serier i dit bibliotek matcher.

# Danish interface strings: English: Nothing airs in the next seven days.
Intet sendes i de næste syv dage.

# Danish interface strings: English: Nothing in this catalogue matches the search. Try another spelling, the original title, or the other catalogue.
Intet i dette katalog matcher søgningen. Prøv en anden stavemåde, den originale titel eller det andet katalog.

# Danish interface strings: English: Number episodes by another order of the catalogue (TMDB episode groups, TheTVDB DVD or absolute order)
Nummerér episoder efter en anden rækkefølge i kataloget (TMDB-episodegrupper, TheTVDB DVD- eller absolut rækkefølge)

# Danish interface strings: English: Only the 2000 newest files are listed.
Only when the proxy needs one.
Opens the service to authorize Kitsunarr and fills in the token.
Åbner tjenesten for at godkende Kitsunarr og udfylder tokenet.

# Danish interface strings: English: Overwrite records that already exist in Kitsunarr (otherwise they are kept)
Overskriv poster, der allerede findes i Kitsunarr (ellers bevares de)

# Danish interface strings: English: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
Adgangskode ændret. Andre sessioner blev logget ud.

# Danish interface strings: English: Pause automation (RSS sync, scheduled list syncs, automatic searches)
Sæt automatisering på pause (RSS-synkronisering, planlagte listesynkroniseringer, automatiske søgninger)

# Danish interface strings: English: Prefer anime season packs (Kitsunarr's anime season searches already search the season once)
Foretræk sæsonpakker for anime (Kitsunarrs sæsonsøgninger for anime søger allerede sæsonen én gang)

# Danish interface strings: English: Profiles still used by series or movies cannot be deleted.
Profiler, der stadig bruges af serier eller film, kan ikke slettes.

# Danish interface strings: English: RSS sync waits this long after a release appears for a better one; delayed releases show in the queue. The first profile whose tags match the series applies; the last one (no tags) is the default.
RSS-synkronisering venter så længe efter, at en udgivelse dukker op, på en bedre; forsinkede udgivelser vises i køen. Den første profil, hvis etiketter matcher serien, anvendes; den sidste (uden etiketter) er standard.

# Danish interface strings: English: Re-encode this series' files with the compression worker

Read live from the download clients every few seconds. Completed downloads Kitsunarr grabbed are imported into the series folder every minute (torrents are copied or hard-linked, so they keep seeding; Usenet downloads are moved). Failed downloads are blocklisted and searched again.
Læses direkte fra downloadklienterne med få sekunders mellemrum. Fuldførte downloads, som Kitsunarr har hentet, importeres til seriemappen hvert minut (torrents kopieres eller hardlinkes, så de fortsat seedes; Usenet-downloads flyttes). Mislykkede downloads blokeres og søges igen.

# Danish interface strings: English: Read-only: finds missing series folders, file records outside their folder or recorded twice, and files missing on disk.
Skrivebeskyttet: finder manglende seriemapper, filposter uden for deres mappe eller registreret to gange og filer, der mangler på disken.

# Danish interface strings: English: Reads everything through the API. Passwords and API keys of providers are hidden by the source and must be re-entered afterwards.
Læser alt via API'et. Udbyderes adgangskoder og API-nøgler skjules af kilden og skal indtastes igen bagefter.

# Danish interface strings: English: Recommended. In Sonarr/Tanukarr open System → Backup, create a backup and download the .zip (or use sonarr.db). Includes indexer and download-client passwords.
Anbefalet. I Sonarr/Tanukarr skal du åbne System → Backup, oprette en sikkerhedskopi og downloade .zip-filen (eller bruge sonarr.db). Indeholder adgangskoder til indeksere og downloadklienter.

# Danish interface strings: English: Refreshing from {} is not supported yet; the imported metadata is kept as is
Opdatering fra {} understøttes endnu ikke; de importerede metadata bevares som de er

# Danish interface strings: English: Reject releases whose TheTVDB or IMDb id names another series
Afvis udgivelser, hvis TheTVDB- eller IMDb-id angiver en anden serie

# Danish interface strings: English: Rejected: click twice to grab anyway
Afvist: klik to gange for at hente alligevel

# Danish interface strings: English: Releases are checked against the series' quality profile, custom formats and release profiles, and ranked, as Sonarr does. Rejected releases ask for a second click.
Udgivelser kontrolleres mod seriens kvalitetsprofil, tilpassede formater og udgivelsesprofiler og rangeres, som Sonarr gør. Afviste udgivelser kræver et ekstra klik.

# Danish interface strings: English: Releases that failed or were blocklisted by hand. Searches and RSS sync never grab them again; remove one to allow it.
Udgivelser, der mislykkedes eller blev blokeret manuelt. Søgninger og RSS-synkronisering henter dem aldrig igen; fjern en for at tillade den.

# Danish interface strings: English: Remove every release from the blocklist?
Remove from the download client (deletes its files there)
Fjern fra downloadklienten (sletter dens filer der)

# Danish interface strings: English: Remove tags automatically (from titles that stop matching)
Fjern etiketter automatisk (fra titler, der ikke længere matcher)

# Danish interface strings: English: Remove “{title}” and its episode records from Kitsunarr?
Fjern “{title}” og dens episodeposter fra Kitsunarr?

# Danish interface strings: English: Remove “{title}” from Kitsunarr? Files on disk are not deleted.
Fjern “{title}” fra Kitsunarr? Filerne på disken slettes ikke.

# Danish interface strings: English: Rename files to the naming settings
Request one at omdbapi.com. Used for films by IMDb id.
Anmod om en på omdbapi.com. Bruges til film via IMDb-id.

# Danish interface strings: English: Saved keys show as {REDACTED}; leave them unchanged to keep them, or clear the field to remove one.
Gemte nøgler vises som {REDACTED}; lad dem være uændrede for at beholde dem, eller ryd feltet for at fjerne en.

# Danish interface strings: English: Search again when a download fails
Søg igen, når en download mislykkes

# Danish interface strings: English: Search every episode of the list, one search per season
Søg efter alle listens episoder, én søgning pr. sæson

# Danish interface strings: English: Search every member's missing episodes (films: the film)
Søg efter hvert medlems manglende episoder (film: filmen)

# Danish interface strings: English: Search the indexers and choose a release
Søg i indekserne, og vælg en udgivelse

# Danish interface strings: English: Search the indexers and grab the best accepted release
Søg i indekserne, og hent den bedste accepterede udgivelse

# Danish interface strings: English: Search the indexers and grab the best releases for the monitored episodes
Søg i indekserne, og hent de bedste udgivelser for de overvågede episoder

# Danish interface strings: English: Season folder titles replace the catalogue's in {{Season Title}}. Leave empty to keep the catalogue's.
Titler på sæsonmapper erstatter katalogets i {{Season Title}}. Lad stå tomt for at beholde katalogets.

# Danish interface strings: English: Season packs: 1 uses the season-pack goals below
Sæsonpakker: 1 bruger målene for sæsonpakker nedenfor

# Danish interface strings: English: Secrets show as {REDACTED}; leave them unchanged to keep the stored value.
Hemmeligheder vises som {REDACTED}; lad dem være uændrede for at beholde den gemte værdi.

# Danish interface strings: English: Seed time, minutes (empty: the client's default)
Send requests to indexers, catalogues, lists, download clients and connections through a proxy.
Send forespørgsler til indeksere, kataloger, lister, downloadklienter og forbindelser gennem en proxy.

# Danish interface strings: English: Series removed from Kitsunarr. Files on disk were not touched.
Serie fjernet fra Kitsunarr. Filerne på disken blev ikke rørt.

# Danish interface strings: English: Series removed, and its folder deleted.
Serie fjernet, og dens mappe slettet.

# Danish interface strings: English: Signed in. Save the list to keep the token.
Logget ind. Gem listen for at beholde tokenet.
Spring filer over, der er mindre end (MB)
Spring kontrol af ledig plads over

# Danish interface strings: English: Skip unmonitored episodes when importing packs
Spring ikke-overvågede episoder over ved import af pakker

# Danish interface strings: English: Subscribe to this address in a calendar app. It contains your API key: keep it private.
Abonnér på denne adresse i en kalenderapp. Den indeholder din API-nøgle: hold den privat.

# Danish interface strings: English: Tag titles already in the library
Giv etiketter til titler, der allerede er i biblioteket

# Danish interface strings: English: Tags are added to series and films that match every kind of condition when they are added, edited or refreshed.
Etiketter tilføjes til serier og film, der matcher alle typer betingelser, når de tilføjes, redigeres eller opdateres.

# Danish interface strings: English: The catalogue new titles are added from when the list knows their id there.
Kataloget, som nye titler tilføjes fra, når listen kender deres id der.

# Danish interface strings: English: The date imported files get: the episode's air date (local or UTC), or on an upgrade the replaced file's date.
Den dato, importerede filer får: episodens sendedato (lokal eller UTC) eller ved en opgradering den erstattede fils dato.

# Danish interface strings: English: The dry run completed without blocking problems. Nothing has been written yet.
Prøvekørslen blev fuldført uden blokerende problemer. Der er endnu ikke skrevet noget.

# Danish interface strings: English: The file is moved into the season folder (an existing file is never overwritten) and the series is rescanned.
Filen flyttes til sæsonmappen (en eksisterende fil overskrives aldrig), og serien scannes igen.

# Danish interface strings: English: The folder must already exist; Kitsunarr never creates or removes it.
Mappen skal allerede findes; Kitsunarr opretter eller fjerner den aldrig.

# Danish interface strings: English: The indexers returned no releases for this search.
Indekserne returnerede ingen udgivelser for denne søgning.

# Danish interface strings: English: The instance is on my local network (private or loopback address)
Instansen er på mit lokale netværk (privat adresse eller loopback-adresse)

# Danish interface strings: English: The list has not been read, or it is empty.
Listen er ikke blevet læst, eller den er tom.

# Danish interface strings: English: The migration did not complete; nothing was changed.
Migreringen blev ikke fuldført; intet blev ændret.

# Danish interface strings: English: The most recent entries kept in memory. Full logs go to the process output (container logs or journal).
De seneste poster i hukommelsen. Fulde logfiler går til processens output (containerlogs eller journal).

# Danish interface strings: English: The recycle bin has no media or subtitle files.
Papirkurven indeholder ingen medie- eller undertekstfiler.

# Danish interface strings: English: The worker is an optional host component (Tanukarr's compression worker) reached through the socket at KITSUNARR_COMPRESSION_SOCKET.
Workeren er en valgfri værtskomponent (Tanukarrs komprimeringsworker), der nås via socket'en i KITSUNARR_COMPRESSION_SOCKET.

# Danish interface strings: English: TheTVDB (Sonarr's catalogue), TMDB and TVmaze cover TV series; AniList and MyAnimeList cover anime series and anime films; TMDB and OMDb cover films. Adding a title creates its library entry and episode list; files are picked up later by the import pipeline.
TheTVDB (Sonarrs katalog), TMDB og TVmaze dækker TV-serier; AniList og MyAnimeList dækker animeserier og animefilm; TMDB og OMDb dækker film. Når en titel tilføjes, oprettes dens post i biblioteket og dens episodeliste; filer opfanges senere af importen.

# Danish interface strings: English: TheTVDB titles are searched and added in this language; each series can be changed in its editor.
TheTVDB-titler søges og tilføjes på dette sprog; hver serie kan ændres i dens editor.

# Danish interface strings: English: TheTVDB titles in this language; changing it refreshes the series
TheTVDB-titler på dette sprog; en ændring opdaterer serien

# Danish interface strings: English: They are created by migrating from Sonarr/Tanukarr.
De oprettes ved migrering fra Sonarr/Tanukarr.

# Danish interface strings: English: This series' renaming mode, season folder titles and kept versions
Seriens omdøbningstilstand, titler på sæsonmapper og bevarede versioner

# Danish interface strings: English: Torznab and Newznab indexers. Use Test in the editor to check one; each search uses the indexers with that kind of search enabled: RSS, automatic or interactive.
Torznab- og Newznab-indeksere. Brug Afprøv i editoren for at kontrollere en; hver søgning bruger de indeksere, der har den type søgning aktiveret: RSS, automatisk eller interaktiv.
Brug hardlinks i stedet for at kopiere

# Danish interface strings: English: Use it as the X-Api-Key header (or ?apikey=) from other applications. Compatible with the header Sonarr uses.
Brug den som X-Api-Key-header (eller ?apikey=) fra andre programmer. Kompatibel med den header, Sonarr bruger.

# Danish interface strings: English: Usenet only: newer releases are rejected, giving them time to propagate. 0 turns this off.
Kun Usenet: nyere udgivelser afvises, så de får tid til at sprede sig. 0 slår dette fra.

# Danish interface strings: English: Usenet only: older releases are rejected. 0 means unlimited.
Kun Usenet: ældre udgivelser afvises. 0 betyder ubegrænset.

# Danish interface strings: English: Webhook, Notifiarr, Discord, Slack, Telegram, Gotify, ntfy, Pushover, Pushbullet, Join, Prowl, Simplepush, Signal, Apprise, e-mail (SMTP), Mailgun, SendGrid, custom scripts (with Sonarr's environment variables), Emby/Jellyfin, Plex and Kodi are sent: grabs, imports and upgrades, renames, series added or deleted, deleted files, health issues. Use Test in the editor.
Webhook, Notifiarr, Discord, Slack, Telegram, Gotify, ntfy, Pushover, Pushbullet, Join, Prowl, Simplepush, Signal, Apprise, e-mail (SMTP), Mailgun, SendGrid, tilpassede scripts (med Sonarrs miljøvariabler), Emby/Jellyfin, Plex og Kodi får besked om: hentninger, importer og opgraderinger, omdøbninger, tilføjede eller slettede serier, slettede filer og sundhedsproblemer. Brug Afprøv i editoren.

# Danish interface strings: English: When HTTPS certificates of indexers, download clients and services are checked (Sonarr's setting). Self-signed certificates on your network need it relaxed.
Hvornår HTTPS-certifikater for indeksere, downloadklienter og tjenester kontrolleres (Sonarrs indstilling). Selvsignerede certifikater på dit netværk kræver, at den lempes.

# Danish interface strings: English: When a download client reports paths Kitsunarr sees elsewhere (another machine or container), map the client's host and path to the local path.
Når en downloadklient rapporterer stier, som Kitsunarr ser et andet sted (en anden maskine eller container), så knyt klientens vært og sti til den lokale sti.

# Danish interface strings: English: Whether releases fixing a bad release are preferred, and upgrade existing files (as in Sonarr).
Om udgivelser, der retter en fejlbehæftet udgivelse, foretrækkes og opgraderer eksisterende filer (som i Sonarr).

# Danish interface strings: English: Written in the series folders when series are scanned, refreshed or imported, as Sonarr's metadata consumers write them.
Skrives i seriemapperne, når serier scannes, opdateres eller importeres, sådan som Sonarrs metadataforbrugere skriver dem.

# Danish interface strings: English: no media files are moved, renamed or deleted.
ingen mediefiler flyttes, omdøbes eller slettes.

# Danish interface strings: English: {} added to every profile (not allowed yet).
{} tilføjet til alle profiler (endnu ikke tilladt).
